scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @splint/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web 'npm run dev --workspace @splint/api' 'npm run dev --workspace @splint/miniapp'
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @splint/shared && npm run build --workspace @splint/miniapp && npm run build --workspace @splint/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @splint/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @splint/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build --workspace @splint/shared && npm run migrate --workspace @splint/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build --workspace @splint/shared && npm run seed --workspace @splint/api
